s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly enlarging breast mass in a premenarcheal girl
salient_findings: Overlying skin tense and shiny with prominent superficial veins
key_facts: No history of pain, trauma, fever, anorexia, or weight loss
Mass not fixed to skin or underlying muscle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology suggestive of fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology suggestive of fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly enlarging breast mass in a premenarcheal girl, although less common than fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Giant fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large size of the breast mass, consistent with giant fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Juvenile fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Age of the patient and characteristics of the breast mass

shortlist.label: Cystosarcoma phyllodes
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth of the breast mass, although less likely than fibroadenoma or phyllodes tumor

raw.rationale: The large size of the breast mass (20 cm × 20 cm) in a premenarcheal girl, combined with ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology results suggestive of fibroadenoma, points towards a giant fibroadenoma, which is a rare variant of fibroadenoma characterized by its large size.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: While the pathology suggests fibroadenoma, the size of the mass is unusually large for a typical fibroadenoma, making giant fibroadenoma a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large but often have a more complex ultrasonographic appearance and may exhibit malignant potential, which is not indicated in this case.

rejected.label: Juvenile fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Juvenile fibroadenoma is a type of fibroadenoma that occurs in young girls, but the term 'giant fibroadenoma' more accurately describes the large size of the tumor in this case.

rejected.label: Cystosarcoma phyllodes
rejected.why: Cystosarcoma phyllodes is an outdated term for phyllodes tumor, which has been ruled out due to the benign nature and specific characteristics of the mass in this case.
